title: Senior Director - Customer Experience and Quality
text:
Job Overview
 
The Sr. Director, Customer Experience & Quality owns the enterprise-wide direction and execution of Vontier Convenience Retails’ global strategy for customer experience, product quality, and reliability. The role serves as the senior advocate for the customer, this leader establishes global standards, governance, and priorities across global functions. Translating customer feedback, field performance, warranty data, and quality insights into priorities that improve products, services, processes, and support. This leader provides oversight and direction for improving the customer experience and connects Design for Reliability, Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Process Control, field quality, and Customer Service & Support into an integrated end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with commercial, product, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and regional leaders, this position drives rapid issue resolution, systemic corrective action, and continuous improvement across the full product life cycle to increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own, create, and execute the enterprise-wide global customer experience and quality strategy, setting direction, priorities, and standards, and measurable objectives that advance business objectives, strengthens customer loyalty, and continuously improves customer outcomes.
* Establish and govern a disciplined enterprise voice-of-customer process that integrates customer feedback, complaints, service data, warranty trends, and field performance into product and operational priorities.
* Own and direct the global customer issue management and escalation process, ensuring rapid containment, transparent communication, root-cause resolution, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Build trusted relationships with strategic customers and customer quality teams; represent the business in quality reviews, escalations, and long-range improvement planning, with accountability for commitments and customer outcomes
* Implement and further develop the Vontier Reliability System to improve product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience across the installed base.
* Develop and lead a multi-year enterprise deployment plan aligned to the customer experience and quality strategy, including performance targets, resources, processes, governance, and organizational capability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Service, Procurement, and Manufacturing to embed customer requirements and quality controls from concept through end of life.
* Develop, govern, and continuously improve an integrated enterprise performance system covering customer satisfaction, complaint responsiveness, repeat issues, field reliability, warranty, external PPM, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Act as the customer experience and quality advisor to the Vontier Convenience Retail Executive team, using data and customer insights to influence priorities, investment decisions, and accountability.
* Build and lead a high-performing global team and foster a culture of customer focus, collaboration, problem solving, prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to travel up to 30% of working time.

Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
 
Essential
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in quality, engineering, operations, service, or customer facing role within a complex product or manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with accountability for quality performance, customer outcomes, and cross-functional improvement.
* Demonstrated success leading complex customer escalations, complaint resolution, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and executive-level customer communication.
* In-depth knowledge of quality management systems, product reliability, continuous improvement methods, and standards such as ISO 9001.
* Ability to translate voice-of-customer, field, warranty, and quality data into priorities, measurable action plans, and improved customer outcomes.
* Strong enterprise program change, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to align global and cross-functional teams around complex business problems, and sustain accountability across functions and regions
* Executive-level communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills with customers, employees, suppliers, and senior leaders; willingness and ability to travel globally.

Preferable
 

* Advanced technical degree or an MBA is a plus.
* ASQ certification or equivalent (e.g., CMQ/OE, CQE)
* Extensive experience in lean manufacturing; including problem solving and use of kaizen
* Experience working with external partners (suppliers, customers, agencies) to accelerate progress and deliver results.
* Worked directly in or in supporting roles to software development, quality assurance, customer roll-out and software investigation and bug fix resolution.
* Customer facing experience working in roles such as customer service, order management, customer success, application engineering, key account management or sales.

Outcomes and Deliverables
 
Deliverables
 

* Global customer experience and quality strategy with a multi-year deployment plan, clear ownership, resources, governance, capability requirements, and measurable business targets.
* Enterprise voice-of-customer and customer issue management processes, including escalation governance, response standards, root-cause resolution, corrective-action verification, and closed-loop customer communication.
* Integrated customer experience and quality performance system, including dashboards and review routines for customer satisfaction, complaint response, repeat issues, reliability, warranty, external PPM, supplier quality, and cost of poor quality.

Outcomes
 

* A doubling of Net Promoter Scores for “Raving Fans” key customers over a 3 year strategic planning horizon

About Vontier
 
**Vontier (NYSE:** VNT) is a global industrial technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves – delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.
